name: PT Multi Hanna Kreasindo Tbk
summary: PT Multi Hanna Kreasindo Tbk engages in the industrial waste management business in Indonesia. The company offers integrated waste transportation, processing, and utilization; liquid waste treatment; medical waste treatment; and solid waste treatment services. PT Multi Hanna Kreasindo Tbk was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Bekasi, Indonesia. The company operates as a subsidiary of PT Multi Hanna Sinergitama.
